purpose: Nine isolated painted body parts per character for rigid joint animation; original artwork retained.

prompts.tall:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production cutout character rig atlas, NOT a sprite animation sequence.
Reference image: the blue/lavender feather-furred gentle monster. Preserve its colors, fluffy feather-like fur, cream/pink belly, pink/purple crown plumes, sunset rim light and charming proportions.
Make a square image with a STRICT 3 by 3 grid of nine ISOLATED body parts on true transparent background. Each part entirely within its equal square cell, generous transparent gutters. No text, no grid lines, no shadows outside the pieces, no assembled characters.
Exact reading order:
1 top left: ONLY the complete round fluffy HEAD including its pink/purple crown and neck fluff. Nearly front-facing, slight 3/4 toward viewer's right. Smooth light-blue/cream muzzle and pink cheeks, but NO EYES, NO MOUTH, NO NOSE: leave face blank so it can be animated in code. Head includes soft round feather cheeks and crown.
2 top middle: ONLY headless armless legless TORSO, upright plump long pear shape, lavender-blue feather fur with a cream-pink belly, fully painted up to rounded neck and shoulder joints; NO limbs, no tail, no face.
3 top right: ONLY LEFT upper arm: short round feather-furred sausage with rounded ends, oriented shoulder at TOP and elbow at BOTTOM; no hand.
4 middle left: ONLY LEFT forearm and paw: elbow at TOP, short forearm downward, cute rounded open three-finger hand at BOTTOM.
5 middle middle: ONLY RIGHT upper arm, shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM, matching opposite arm.
6 middle right: ONLY RIGHT forearm and paw, elbow TOP and rounded open three-finger hand at BOTTOM.
7 bottom left: ONLY fluffy curved TAIL, attachment/root at RIGHT edge and plumed tip curving up at LEFT. Rounded fully painted root for a pivot.
8 bottom middle: ONLY LEFT leg and broad rounded three-toed FOOT, hip at TOP, toes at BOTTOM facing slightly outward.
9 bottom right: ONLY RIGHT leg and broad rounded three-toed FOOT, hip TOP, toes BOTTOM.
Use the same physical scale for the paired arms and legs; head and torso may use more of their cells. Every part has complete rounded overlap at joints so animated rotations never leave holes. Soft high-quality painted 3D storybook rendering matching reference, clean alpha edges. The output is a reusable animation puppet kit, not nine full monsters.
prompts.green:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production articulated character rig atlas.
Image 1 is a LAYOUT AND PARTS reference: the nine isolated pieces in a strict 3x3 grid. Image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Create the same 3x3 animation puppet kit for this character: moss/sage-green shy furry monster with pale mint/cream belly, rounded leaf-like fur, small pink blossoms and green leaf tufts on its crown; plump pear-shaped torso, gentle fluffy round head and small green paws; no blue or magenta crown.
Keep the soft painted storybook 3D treatment, peach sunset rim light, detailed textures and charming appearance of Image 2.
TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no checkerboard, no shadows outside pieces, no text, no gridlines. Nine isolated parts, each centered inside its equal-sized cell with 8% transparent padding. No parts overlap or cross cell boundaries. No complete assembled character anywhere.
Exact row-major parts:
1 complete HEAD with crown/gills/antennae and rounded neck fluff; near-front view slightly toward viewer's right. Blank smooth face and pink cheeks: NO EYES, NO MOUTH, NO NOSE, facial features will be animated separately.
2 complete headless armless legless TORSO with cream belly, round neck and shoulder stumps, no face, no tail.
3 LEFT UPPER ARM ONLY, shoulder at TOP, elbow BOTTOM; no hand.
4 LEFT FOREARM + open rounded PAW/FLIPPER, elbow at TOP, fingers BOTTOM.
5 RIGHT UPPER ARM ONLY, shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM.
6 RIGHT FOREARM + open rounded PAW/FLIPPER, elbow TOP fingers BOTTOM.
7 TAIL ONLY, root at RIGHT, tip curving up at LEFT.
8 LEFT leg + FOOT, hip TOP, toes BOTTOM.
9 RIGHT leg + FOOT, hip TOP, toes BOTTOM.
Full rounded painted overlaps at each joint, no holes. Consistent paired limb scale and materials. Preserve the species-specific silhouette. Output square atlas ready to slice into nine pieces, matching the layout of Image 1.
